1: -module(quod_agent_failover_SUITE).
    2: -moduledoc """
    3: Four real QUIC validators retain quorum after host VM loss or suspension.
    4: Three surviving node actors observe that host; the ontology requires two reports
    5: and chooses between two eligible destinations. Replacement custody is generated
    6: by the ordinary recovery reaction, never installed by the test.
    7: The former host returns from retained custody, either rebooted or still running,
    8: without failback.
    9: """.
   10: -include_lib("common_test/include/ct.hrl").
   11: -include_lib("stdlib/include/assert.hrl").
   12: -include("quod_ledger.hrl").
   13: -export([all/0, init_per_testcase/2, end_per_testcase/2,
   14:          validator_host_loss_recovers_state/1,
   15:          abrupt_host_loss_recovers_state/1,
   16:          suspended_host_retires_stale_process/1,
   17:          uncertain_claim_recovers_after_quorum_loss/1,
   18:          uncertain_claim_recovers_after_target_restart/1]).
   19: -export([hold_claim_admission/3, begin_uncertain_claim/1,
   20:          release_claim_and_await_expiry/3]).
   21: -export([bind_node/2, submit_node/1, await_goal/3, await_agent/3, await_observer/2, await_process_down/2,
   22:          resumed_work/4, restart_runtime/2, diagnostics/0,
   23:          operation_diagnostics/2,
   24:          await_node_principal/2, assert_old_key_fenced/2]).
   25: 
   26: -define(NS, <<"agent:failover">>).
   27: -define(ROOT, <<"quod:root">>).
   28: 
   29: all() -> [validator_host_loss_recovers_state, abrupt_host_loss_recovers_state,
   30:           suspended_host_retires_stale_process,
   31:           uncertain_claim_recovers_after_quorum_loss,
   32:           uncertain_claim_recovers_after_target_restart].
   33: 
   34: init_per_testcase(TestCase, Config0) ->
   35:     Config = [{host_loss, TestCase} | Config0],
   36:     put(failover_peers, []),
   37:     try
   38:         Pairs = lists:sort([quod_identity:generate() || _ <- lists:seq(1, 4)]),
   39:         Nodes0 = [start_node(I, Pair, Config)
   40:                   || {I, Pair} <- lists:zip(lists:seq(1, 4), Pairs)],
   41:         learn_peers(Nodes0),
   42:         [_Old0, Administrator0 | _] = Nodes0,
   43:         RootAnchor = start_shared_ontology(Administrator0, Nodes0, ?ROOT,
   44:             "quod_root.pl", [quod_directory_predicates,quod_ontology_predicates]),
   45:         OwnerAnchor = start_shared_ontology(Administrator0, Nodes0, <<"quod:agent">>,
   46:             "quod_agent.pl", [quod_agent_predicates]),
   47:         Nodes = [start_node_ontology(N#{agent_owner_anchor => OwnerAnchor}) || N <- Nodes0],
   48:         [Old, Administrator | _] = Nodes,
   49:         Observers = tl(Nodes),
   50:         Eligible = lists:sublist(Observers, 2),
   51:         AgentAnchor = start_agent_ontology(Nodes, Observers, Eligible, Administrator),
   52:         install_grants(Observers, Old, AgentAnchor),
   53:         replicate_node_histories(Nodes),
   54:         install_contacts(Nodes, Nodes, RootAnchor, AgentAnchor, Administrator),
   55:         AgentRef = {agent_instance_ref, ?NS, AgentAnchor, actor},
   56:         {ok, Blob} = quod_wire_term:encode_canonical(AgentRef),
   57:         {ok, OldKey} = call(Old, quod_agent_vault, prepare, [Blob, 0]),
   58:         OldRef = maps:get(reference, Old),
   59:         committed(call(Administrator, ?MODULE, submit_node,
   60:             [{node_authorized_goal, ?NS, AgentAnchor,
   61:               agent({goal, {agent_hosted, AgentRef, OldRef, 1, OldKey}})}])),
   62:         {_InitialBinding, InitialHeight} = call(Old, ?MODULE, await_goal,
   63:             [?NS, {agent_hosted, actor, OldRef, 1, OldKey}, 30000]),
   64:         {OldRuntime, OldChild, _} = call(Old, ?MODULE, await_agent, [AgentRef, 1, 10000]),
   65:         lists:foreach(fun(N) ->
   66:             ok = call(N, quod_ct, await_applied, [?NS, InitialHeight, 30000]),
   67:             ok = call(N, ?MODULE, await_observer, [InitialHeight, 10000]),
   68:             ?assertMatch(#{mode := live, collapses := 0}, call(N, quod_runtime, stats, [?NS]))
   69:         end, Observers),
   70:         [{nodes, Nodes}, {observers, Observers}, {eligible, Eligible},
   71:          {agent_ref, AgentRef}, {root_anchor, RootAnchor}, {old_key, OldKey},
   72:          {old_runtime, OldRuntime}, {old_child, OldChild} | Config]
   73:     catch Class:Reason:Stack ->
   74:         stop_peers(get(failover_peers)),
   75:         erlang:raise(Class, Reason, Stack)
   76:     end.
   77: 
   78: end_per_testcase(_TestCase, Config) ->
   79:     stop_peers([maps:get(peer, N) || N <- ?config(nodes, Config)]),
   80:     ok.
   81: 
   82: %% Keep all transports and hosted children alive. Suspend two of four target
   83: %% consensus owners only AFTER the ordinary signed source claim commits. Proof
   84: %% admission therefore succeeded with quorum; the fault tests delivery custody.
   85: uncertain_claim_recovers_after_quorum_loss(Config) ->
   86:     uncertain_claim_recovers(Config, false).
   87: 
   88: uncertain_claim_recovers_after_target_restart(Config) ->
   89:     uncertain_claim_recovers(Config, true).
   90: 
   91: uncertain_claim_recovers(Config, Restart) ->
   92:     ct:timetrap({minutes, 3}),
   93:     [A, B, C, D] = Nodes = ?config(nodes, Config),
   94:     {agent_instance_ref, ?NS, Anchor, actor} = ?config(agent_ref, Config),
   95:     Goal = {node_authorized_goal, ?NS, Anchor, {record_delivery, durable_delivery}},
   96:     {Prolog, Token, Tx, ClaimRef, OperationRef, Bytes, Signature} =
   97:         call(B, ?MODULE, begin_uncertain_claim, [Goal]),
   98:     SourceNs = maps:get(node_namespace, B),
   99:     ?assertMatch({ok, #{status := claimed}}, call(B, quod_prolog, outcome, [OperationRef])),
  100:     Held = [{N, call(N, quod_reg, where, [{quod_simplex, ?NS}])} || N <- [A, D]],
  101:     try
  102:         lists:foreach(fun({N, Owner}) -> ok = call(N, sys, suspend, [Owner]) end, Held),
  103:         TargetRef = {transaction, ?NS, Anchor, Tx},
  104:         ok = call(B, ?MODULE, release_claim_and_await_expiry, [Prolog, Token, Tx]),
  105:         ?assertMatch({ok, #{status := pending}}, call(B, quod_prolog, outcome, [TargetRef])),
  106:         ?assertMatch({ok, #{operation_state := unresolved}},
  107:                      call(B, quod_prolog, outcome, [OperationRef])),
  108:         %% Fixture caller TTL is shorter than the observed custody deadline.
  109:         ?assertEqual(0, maps:get(parked, call(B, quod_prolog, stats, [?NS]))),
  110:         case Restart of
  111:             true ->
  112:                 %% Drop every target's volatile proposals/relay mailboxes while
  113:                 %% retaining all four ledgers. Otherwise a late old proposal can
  114:                 %% complete even on the broken implementation. Source ontology
  115:                 %% owners and their original committed claim stay running.
  116:                 lists:foreach(fun(N) ->
  117:                     ok = call(N, quod_ns_sup, stop_namespace, [?NS])
  118:                 end, [A, D, B, C]),
  119:                 lists:foreach(fun(N) ->
  120:                     start_namespace(N, ?NS, #{mode => join, genesis_hash => Anchor,
  121:                         seed_peers => [maps:get(endpoint, Other) || Other <- Nodes, Other =/= N]})
  122:                 end, Nodes);
  123:             false ->
  124:                 lists:foreach(fun({N, Owner}) -> ok = call(N, sys, resume, [Owner]) end, Held)
  125:         end,
  126:         %% Only real consensus/application progress may wake the existing
  127:         %% source coordinator. The test never resubmits the signed goal/claim.
  128:         #{operation_state := terminal} =
  129:             call(B, quod_ct, await_operation_complete, [SourceNs, OperationRef, 60000]),
  130:         ?assertMatch({ok, _, {operation_outcome, #{operation_state := terminal},
  131:                              #{status := completed}}},
  132:             call(B, quod_client_goal_ingress, resolve_operation, [Bytes, Signature])),
  133:         {ok, #{status := committed, height := Height}} =
  134:             call(B, quod_prolog, outcome, [TargetRef]),
  135:         lists:foreach(fun(N) ->
  136:             Deadline = quod_time:mono_ms() + 30000,
  137:             ok = call(N, quod_ct, await_applied, [?NS, Height, 30000]),
  138:             {Bindings, ObservedHeight} = call(N, ?MODULE, await_goal,
  139:                 [?NS, {findall, {'X'}, {delivered, {'X'}}, [durable_delivery]},
  140:                  max(0, Deadline - quod_time:mono_ms())]),
  141:             ?assert(is_map(Bindings)),
  142:             ?assert(ObservedHeight >= Height)
  143:         end, Nodes),
  144:         ?assertMatch({ok, #{status := committed}}, call(B, quod_prolog, outcome, [ClaimRef])),
  145:         ct:pal("Original operation completed after custody expiry; restart=~p, target height=~p",
  146:                [Restart, Height])
  147:     catch Class:Reason:Stack ->
  148:         ct:pal("Original claim recovery: ~p", [
  149:             catch call(B, ?MODULE, operation_diagnostics, [SourceNs, OperationRef])]),
  150:         lists:foreach(fun(N) ->
  151:             ct:pal("Node ~p recovery state: ~p", [maps:get(node_namespace, N),
  152:                 catch call(N, ?MODULE, diagnostics, [])])
  153:         end, Nodes),
  154:         erlang:raise(Class, Reason, Stack)
  155:     after
  156:         lists:foreach(fun({N, Owner}) -> catch call(N, sys, resume, [Owner]) end, Held),
  157:         catch call(B, erlang, send, [Prolog, {release_claim, Token}]),
  158:         catch call(B, sys, remove, [Prolog, Token])
  159:     end.
  160: 
  161: begin_uncertain_claim(Goal) ->
  162:     Prolog = quod_reg:where({quod_prolog, ?NS}),
  163:     Token = make_ref(), Parent = self(),
  164:     ok = sys:install(Prolog, {Token, fun ?MODULE:hold_claim_admission/3, {Parent, Token}}),
  165:     {Numbered, _, _} = erlog_int:term_instance(Goal, 0),
  166:     {ok, Bytes, Signature} = quod_node_actor:signed_goal(execute, Numbered,
  167:         crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32), quod_time:now_ms() + 30000),
  168:     spawn(fun() -> Parent ! {claim_submission_result, Token,
  169:                             quod_client_goal_ingress:submit(Bytes, Signature)} end),
  170:     receive
  171:         {claim_held, Token, Tx, ClaimRef, OperationRef} ->
  172:             {Prolog, Token, Tx, ClaimRef, OperationRef, Bytes, Signature};
  173:         {claim_submission_result, Token, Result} ->
  174:             error({submission_ended_before_claim_gate, Result})
  175:     after 15000 -> error(claim_not_admitted)
  176:     end.
  177: 
  178: hold_claim_admission({Parent, Token},
  179:   {in, {'$gen_call', _, {submit_role,
  180:     #transaction{tx_id = Tx, role = {remote_application, ClaimRef, OperationRef, _}}, _, _}}}, _) ->
  181:     Parent ! {claim_held, Token, Tx, ClaimRef, OperationRef},
  182:     receive {release_claim, Token} -> done
  183:     after 15000 -> error(claim_gate_not_released)
  184:     end;
  185: hold_claim_admission(State, _, _) -> State.
  186: 
  187: release_claim_and_await_expiry(Prolog, Token, Tx) ->
  188:     Owner = quod_reg:where({quod_simplex, ?NS}),
  189:     Pattern = {quod_simplex, complete_custody, 3},
  190:     erlang:trace_pattern(Pattern,
  191:         [{['_', {error, not_in_charge, unavailable}, '_'], [], [{return_trace}]}], [local]),
  192:     erlang:trace(Owner, true, [call, {tracer, self()}]),
  193:     try
  194:         Prolog ! {release_claim, Token},
  195:         receive
  196:             {trace, Owner, call, {quod_simplex, complete_custody, [Id, _, State]}} ->
  197:                 [{Id, _, {submit, _, _, Canonical}, _, _, _}] =
  198:                     [Row || Row <- quod_simplex:test_custody(State), element(1, Row) =:= Id],
  199:                 {ok, #{tx_id := Tx}} = quod_transaction:decode_submission_metadata(Canonical)
  200:         after 45000 -> error(custody_did_not_expire_without_quorum)
  201:         end,
  202:         receive {trace, Owner, return_from, Pattern, _} -> ok
  203:         after 1000 -> error(custody_expiry_did_not_complete) end,
  204:         {_, Current} = sys:get_state(Owner),
  205:         ?assertEqual([], quod_simplex:test_custody(Current)),
  206:         ok
  207:     after
  208:         erlang:trace(Owner, false, [call]),
  209:         erlang:trace_pattern(Pattern, false, [local])
  210:     end.
  211: 
  212: abrupt_host_loss_recovers_state(Config) ->
  213:     validator_host_loss_recovers_state(Config).
  214: 
  215: suspended_host_retires_stale_process(Config) ->
  216:     validator_host_loss_recovers_state(Config).
  217: 
  218: validator_host_loss_recovers_state(Config) ->
  219:     ct:timetrap({minutes, 3}),
  220:     try exercise_host_loss(Config)
  221:     catch Class:Reason:Stack ->
  222:         lists:foreach(fun(N) ->
  223:             Snapshot = catch call(N, ?MODULE, diagnostics, []),
  224:             ct:pal("Survivor ~p diagnostics: ~p", [maps:get(node_namespace, N), Snapshot])
  225:         end, tl(?config(nodes, Config))),
  226:         erlang:raise(Class, Reason, Stack)
  227:     end.
  228: 
  229: exercise_host_loss(Config) ->
  230:     [Old | Survivors] = ?config(nodes, Config),
  231:     {agent_instance_ref, ?NS, Anchor, actor} = ?config(agent_ref, Config),
  232:     lists:foreach(fun(N) ->
  233:         ?assertMatch(#{role := validator}, call(N, quod_simplex, status, [?NS]))
  234:     end, [Old | Survivors]),
  235:     lists:foreach(fun(N) ->
  236:         %% These vaults have not prepared or received an agent private key.
  237:         ?assertEqual({ok, []}, call(N, file, list_dir, [maps:get(vault_dir, N)]))
  238:     end, ?config(eligible, Config)),
  239:     [Administrator | _] = Survivors,
  240:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {failed, _}}},
  241:         call(Administrator, ?MODULE, submit_node,
  242:           [{node_authorized_goal, ?NS, Anchor, {assertz, unauthorized_recovery}}])),
  243:     Fault = stop_host(Old, Config),
  244:     ct:pal("Host fault accepted at ~p", [quod_time:mono_ms()]),
  245:     try exercise_recovery(Config, Fault)
  246:     after
  247:         %% Closing the controller's stdin resumes its exact peer on failure.
  248:         case Fault of stopped -> ok; {suspended, P} -> catch port_close(P) end
  249:     end.
  250: 
  251: exercise_recovery(Config, Fault) ->
  252:     [Old | Survivors] = ?config(nodes, Config),
  253:     AgentRef = {agent_instance_ref, ?NS, Anchor, actor} = ?config(agent_ref, Config),
  254:     OldKey = ?config(old_key, Config),
  255:     [Administrator | _] = Survivors,
  256:     {#{'Host' := NewHost, 'Key' := NewKey}, RecoveryHeight} =
  257:         call(Administrator, ?MODULE, await_goal,
  258:              [?NS, {agent_hosted, actor, {'Host'}, 2, {'Key'}}, 90000]),
  259:     ct:pal("Committed epoch 2 at height ~p, time ~p", [RecoveryHeight, quod_time:mono_ms()]),
  260:     [Destination] = [N || N <- ?config(eligible, Config), maps:get(reference, N) =:= NewHost],
  261:     ?assertNotEqual(OldKey, NewKey),
  262:     {Runtime, Child, #{public_key := NewKey}} =
  263:         call(Destination, ?MODULE, await_agent, [AgentRef, 2, 10000]),
  264:     ?assertNotEqual(?config(old_runtime, Config), Runtime),
  265:     ?assertNotEqual(?config(old_child, Config), Child),
  266:     assert_replicated(Survivors, RecoveryHeight, NewHost, NewKey, OldKey, []),
  267:     WorkHeight = call(Destination, ?MODULE, resumed_work,
  268:                       [AgentRef, Runtime, Child, after_recovery]),
  269:     assert_replicated(Survivors, WorkHeight, NewHost, NewKey, OldKey, [after_recovery]),
  270:     {NextRuntime, NextChild, #{public_key := NewKey}} =
  271:         call(Destination, ?MODULE, restart_runtime, [AgentRef, Runtime]),
  272:     ?assertNotEqual(Runtime, NextRuntime),
  273:     ?assertNotEqual(Child, NextChild),
  274:     RestartHeight = call(Destination, ?MODULE, resumed_work,
  275:                          [AgentRef, NextRuntime, NextChild, after_runtime_restart]),
  276:     assert_replicated(Survivors, RestartHeight, NewHost, NewKey, OldKey,
  277:                       [after_recovery, after_runtime_restart]),
  278:     ct:pal("Replacement work committed before host return at ~p", [quod_time:mono_ms()]),
  279:     Returned = case Fault of
  280:         stopped -> boot_node(Old);
  281:         {suspended, Port} ->
  282:             ok = restore_host({suspended, Port}),
  283:             Old
  284:     end,
  285:     try
  286:         case Fault of
  287:             stopped -> resume_host(Returned, Survivors, ?config(root_anchor, Config), Anchor);
  288:             {suspended, _} -> ok
  289:         end,
  290:         assert_replicated([Returned], RestartHeight, NewHost, NewKey, OldKey,
  291:                           [after_recovery, after_runtime_restart]),
  292:         case Fault of
  293:             {suspended, _} ->
  294:                 ok = call(Returned, ?MODULE, await_process_down,
  295:                           [?config(old_child, Config), 10000]);
  296:             stopped -> ok
  297:         end,
  298:         {_, ReturnedChildren} = call(Returned, quod_runtime, agents, [?NS]),
  299:         ?assertEqual([], [B || #{binding := #{reference := R} = B} <- ReturnedChildren,
  300:                               R =:= AgentRef]),
  301:         case Fault of
  302:             {suspended, _} ->
  303:                 %% The same VM and runtime must retire their surviving old child
  304:                 %% when committed state catches up; no test-triggered restart.
  305:                 {ReturnedRuntime, _} = call(Returned, quod_runtime, agents, [?NS]),
  306:                 ?assertEqual(?config(old_runtime, Config), ReturnedRuntime),
  307:                 ?assertNot(call(Returned, erlang, is_process_alive, [?config(old_child, Config)]));
  308:             stopped -> ok
  309:         end,
  310:         ok = call(Returned, ?MODULE, assert_old_key_fenced, [AgentRef, OldKey]),
  311:         FinalHeight = call(Destination, ?MODULE, resumed_work,
  312:                           [AgentRef, NextRuntime, NextChild, after_old_host_return]),
  313:         All = [Returned | Survivors],
  314:         assert_replicated(All, FinalHeight, NewHost, NewKey, OldKey, work_values()),
  315:         lists:foreach(fun(N) ->
  316:             ?assertMatch(#{mode := live, collapses := 0, reconcile_failures := 0},
  317:                          call(N, quod_runtime, stats, [?NS])),
  318:             ?assertMatch(#{role := validator}, call(N, quod_simplex, status, [?NS])),
  319:             {_, Children} = call(N, quod_runtime, agents, [?NS]),
  320:             Hosted = [B || #{binding := #{reference := R} = B} <- Children, R =:= AgentRef],
  321:             Expected = case maps:get(reference, N) =:= NewHost of true -> 1; false -> 0 end,
  322:             ?assertEqual(Expected, length(Hosted))
  323:         end, All)
  324:     after stop_peers([maps:get(peer, Returned)]) end.
  325: 
  326: resume_host(Returned, Survivors = [Administrator | _], RootAnchor, AgentAnchor) ->
  327:     Seeds = [maps:get(endpoint, N) || N <- Survivors],
  328:     resume_namespace(Returned, ?ROOT, RootAnchor, [maps:get(endpoint, Administrator)]),
  329:     resume_namespace(Returned, <<"quod:agent">>, maps:get(agent_owner_anchor,Returned),
  330:                      [maps:get(endpoint, Administrator)]),
  331:     learn_peers([Returned | Survivors]),
  332:     %% The persisted pointer restores the own node actor; do not bind it again.
  333:     ok = call(Returned, ?MODULE, await_node_principal,
  334:               [maps:get(reference, Returned), 10000]),
  335:     lists:foreach(fun(N) ->
  336:         resume_namespace(Returned, maps:get(node_namespace, N), maps:get(node_anchor, N),
  337:                          [maps:get(endpoint, N)])
  338:     end, Survivors),
  339:     resume_namespace(Returned, ?NS, AgentAnchor, Seeds),
  340:     {ok, _} = call(Returned, quod_brahms, start_namespace,
  341:                   [?NS, #{node_id => maps:get(endpoint, Returned), seed_peers => Seeds}]),
  342:     install_contacts([Returned], [Returned | Survivors], RootAnchor, AgentAnchor, Administrator).
  343: 
  344: resume_namespace(N, Ns, Anchor, Seeds) ->
  345:     %% Fixture namespaces have no committed hosting intent. Require their old
  346:     %% ledgers explicitly; this must not pass by founding or downloading anew.
  347:     {ok, Resume} = call(N, quod_ontology, prepare_local_resume,
  348:                        [Ns, Anchor, maps:get(data_dir, N)]),
  349:     start_namespace(N, Ns, Resume#{seed_peers => Seeds}),
  350:     ?assertEqual(Anchor, call(N, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [Ns])).
  351: 
  352: assert_replicated(Nodes, Height, Host, Key, OldKey, Work) ->
  353:     Goal = conjunction([
  354:         {findall, {host, {'H'}, {'E'}, {'K'}},
  355:             {agent_host, actor, {'H'}, {'E'}, {'K'}}, [{host, Host, 2, Key}]},
  356:         {findall, {'K'}, {agent_key, actor, {'K'}, active}, [Key]},
  357:         {findall, {'K'}, {agent_key, actor, {'K'}, revoked}, [OldKey]},
  358:         {agent_domain_state, actor, before_loss},
  359:         {findall, {'Value'}, {recovered_work, {'Value'}}, Work},
  360:         {'\\+', unauthorized_recovery},
  361:         {'\\+', {agent_recovery_round, actor, {'_'}, {'_'}, {'_'}}},
  362:         {'\\+', {agent_failure_report, actor, {'_'}, {'_'}, {'_'}, {'_'}, {'_'}, {'_'}}},
  363:         {'\\+', {agent_candidate_key, actor, {'_'}, {'_'}, {'_'}, {'_'}}}]),
  364:     lists:foreach(fun(N) ->
  365:         Deadline = quod_time:mono_ms() + 30000,
  366:         ok = call(N, quod_ct, await_applied, [?NS, Height, 30000]),
  367:         %% Reaching the applied height does not finish the replay handshake.
  368:         %% Observe the existing readiness edge within the same allowance.
  369:         {Bindings, ObservedHeight} = call(N, ?MODULE, await_goal,
  370:             [?NS, Goal, max(0, Deadline - quod_time:mono_ms())]),
  371:         ?assert(is_map(Bindings)),
  372:         ?assert(ObservedHeight >= Height)
  373:     end, Nodes).
  374: 
  375: stop_host(Old, Config) ->
  376:     stop_host(Old, ?config(host_loss, Config), Config).
  377: 
  378: stop_host(#{peer := Peer}, validator_host_loss_recovers_state, _Config) ->
  379:     ok = peer:stop(Peer),
  380:     stopped;
  381: stop_host(#{peer := Peer}, abrupt_host_loss_recovers_state, _Config) ->
  382:     Monitor = monitor(process, Peer),
  383:     %% No application shutdown, output flush, port cleanup or pending I/O drain.
  384:     ok = peer:cast(Peer, erlang, halt, [137, [{flush, false}]]),
  385:     receive
  386:         {'DOWN', Monitor, process, Peer, {exit_status, 137}} -> stopped;
  387:         {'DOWN', Monitor, process, Peer, Reason} -> ct:fail({unexpected_host_exit, Reason})
  388:     after 10000 -> ct:fail(host_did_not_exit)
  389:     end;
  390: stop_host(Old, suspended_host_retires_stale_process, Config) ->
  391:     Python = os:find_executable("python3"),
  392:     Script = filename:join(?config(data_dir, Config), "suspend_peer.py"),
  393:     Pid = call(Old, os, getpid, []),
  394:     Port = open_port({spawn_executable, Python},
  395:                      [{args, [Script, Pid]}, binary, {line, 1024}, exit_status, stderr_to_stdout]),
  396:     try
  397:         ok = fault_reply(Port, <<"stop_accepted">>, quod_time:mono_ms() + 10000, []),
  398:         {suspended, Port}
  399:     catch Class:Reason:Stack ->
  400:         catch port_close(Port),
  401:         erlang:raise(Class, Reason, Stack)
  402:     end.
  403: 
  404: restore_host({suspended, Port}) ->
  405:     true = port_command(Port, <<"resume\n">>),
  406:     try
  407:         ok = fault_reply(Port, <<"resumed">>, quod_time:mono_ms() + 10000, []),
  408:         receive {Port, {exit_status, 0}} -> ok;
  409:                 {Port, Exit} -> error({host_resumption_exit, Exit})
  410:         after 10000 -> error(host_resumption_exit_timeout)
  411:         end
  412:     after catch port_close(Port) end.
  413: 
  414: fault_reply(Port, Expected, Deadline, Lines) ->
  415:     receive
  416:         {Port, {data, {eol, Expected}}} -> ok;
  417:         {Port, {data, {_, Line}}} -> fault_reply(Port, Expected, Deadline, [Line | Lines]);
  418:         {Port, Exit} -> error({fault_controller_failed, Expected, Exit, lists:reverse(Lines)})
  419:     after max(0, Deadline - quod_time:mono_ms()) ->
  420:         error({fault_controller_timeout, Expected, lists:reverse(Lines)})
  421:     end.
  422: 
  423: start_node(Index, Pair = {Pub, _}, Config) ->
  424:     {ok, Socket} = gen_udp:open(0),
  425:     {ok, Port} = inet:port(Socket),
  426:     ok = gen_udp:close(Socket),
  427:     Dir = filename:join([?config(priv_dir, Config), atom_to_list(?config(host_loss, Config)),
  428:                          "peer-" ++ integer_to_list(Index)]),
  429:     Unlock = filename:join(Dir, "vault-unlock"),
  430:     ok = quod_file:write_atomic(Unlock, crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32), 8#600),
  431:     VaultDir = filename:join(Dir, "keys"),
  432:     Name = list_to_atom("agent_failover_" ++ integer_to_list(Port)),
  433:     Identity = #{pubkey => Pub, key => quod_identity:key_term(Pair)},
  434:     N = #{peer_name => Name, public_key => Pub, identity => Identity,
  435:           endpoint => {"127.0.0.1", Port}, data_dir => Dir, vault_dir => VaultDir,
  436:           node_namespace => <<"failover-node-", (integer_to_binary(Index))/binary>>},
  437:     Env = [{listen_port, Port}, {metrics_port, 0}, {node_addr, maps:get(endpoint, N)},
  438:            {node_pubkey, Pub}, {identity_key, maps:get(key, Identity)},
  439:            {identity_cert, quod_identity:mint_cert(Pair)},
  440:            {identity_dir, filename:join(Dir, "identity")}, {content_data_dir, Dir},
  441:            {simplex_delta_ms, 4000}, {effect_journal_data_dir, Dir},
  442:            {foreign_log, #{cache_dir => filename:join(Dir, "foreign-history")}},
  443:            {directory, #{ttl_ms => 600000, expire_tick_ms => 60000}},
  444:            {agent_vault, #{directory => VaultDir, unlock_file => Unlock}}],
  445:     boot_node(N#{boot_env => Env}).
  446: 
  447: boot_node(N0 = #{peer_name := Name, boot_env := Env, data_dir := Dir}) ->
  448:     Ebin = filename:dirname(code:which(quod_simplex)),
  449:     Paths = [Ebin | lists:delete(Ebin, code:get_path())],
  450:     {ok, Peer, _} = peer:start(#{name => Name, connection => standard_io, peer_down => crash,
  451:                                 args => ["+S", "2:2", "-pa" | Paths]}),
  452:     Peers = case get(failover_peers) of undefined -> []; Existing -> Existing end,
  453:     put(failover_peers, [Peer | Peers]),
  454:     N = N0#{peer => Peer},
  455:     try
  456:         true = call(N, os, putenv, ["XDG_CACHE_HOME", filename:join(Dir, "cache")]),
  457:         ok = call(N, logger, set_primary_config, [level, warning]),
  458:         ok = call(N, application, load, [quod]),
  459:         lists:foreach(fun({K, V}) -> ok = call(N, application, set_env, [quod, K, V]) end, Env),
  460:         {ok, _} = call(N, application, ensure_all_started, [quod]),
  461:         {module, ?MODULE} = call(N, code, ensure_loaded, [?MODULE]),
  462:         Ebin = filename:dirname(call(N, code, which, [quod_simplex])),
  463:         N
  464:     catch Class:Reason:Stack ->
  465:         stop_peers([Peer]),
  466:         erlang:raise(Class, Reason, Stack)
  467:     end.

  474:         end, Nodes -- [N])
  475:     end, Nodes).

  477: start_shared_ontology(Founder, Nodes, Ns, File, Modules) ->
  478:     Source = filename:join([code:priv_dir(quod), "ontologies", File]),
  479:     start_namespace(Founder, Ns,
  480:         #{mode => create, genesis_file => Source, external_predicate_modules => Modules}),
  481:     Anchor = call(Founder, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [Ns]),
  482:     lists:foreach(fun(N) ->
  483:         start_namespace(N, Ns, join_config(Founder, Anchor))
  484:     end, Nodes -- [Founder]),
  485:     lists:foreach(fun(N) -> ok = call(N, quod_ct, await_applied, [Ns, 1, 30000]) end, Nodes),
  486:     Anchor.

  488: start_node_ontology(N = #{node_namespace := Ns, public_key := Pub}) ->
  489:     {ok, Execution} = erlog_io:read_file(filename:join(code:priv_dir(quod),
  490:                                                      "ontologies/node_instance.pl")),
  491:     Principal = {agent_instance_ref, Ns, {'_'}, physical_node},
  492:     SigningPrincipal = {agent_instance_ref, Ns, {'NodeAnchor'}, physical_node},
  493:     SigningRead = {'::', ?NS,
  494:         {',', {agent_hosted, actor, SigningPrincipal, {'Epoch'}, {'Key'}},
  495:          {sign_agent_request, {'Request'}, {'Signature'}}}},
  496:     Terms = Execution ++ [
  497:         {instance_of, node, physical_node}, {agent_key, physical_node, Pub, active},
  498:         {can_invoke, {node_authorized_goal, ?NS, {'_'}, {'_'}}, Principal, {'_'}, Ns},
  499:         {can_invoke, {assertz, {can_execute_for, ?NS, {'_'}, {'_'}}}, Principal, {'_'}, Ns},
  500:         {can_invoke, SigningRead, SigningPrincipal, {'_'}, Ns}],
  501:     start_namespace(N, Ns, #{mode => create, genesis_diff => quod_prolog:terms_to_diff(Terms)}),
  502:     ok = call(N, quod_ct, await_applied, [Ns, 1, 10000]),
  503:     Anchor = call(N, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [Ns]),
  504:     {ok, PrincipalValue} = call(N, ?MODULE, bind_node, [Ns, Anchor]),
  505:     Ref = {agent_instance_ref, Ns, Anchor, physical_node},
  506:     {ok, PrincipalValue} = call(N, quod_node_actor, principal, []),
  507:     N#{reference => Ref, node_anchor => Anchor}.

  509: start_agent_ontology([Founder | Others], Observers, Eligible, Administrator) ->
  510:     {ok, Instance} = erlog_io:read_file(filename:join(code:priv_dir(quod),
  511:                                                     "ontologies/agent_instance.pl")),
  512:     {ok, Recovery} = erlog_io:read_file(filename:join(code:priv_dir(quod),
  513:                                                     "ontologies/agent_recovery_policy.pl")),
  514:     Terms = Instance ++ Recovery ++ agent_policy(Founder, Observers, Eligible, Administrator),
  515:     Committee = [{maps:get(public_key, N), Host, Port}
  516:                  || N <- Others, {Host, Port} <- [maps:get(endpoint, N)]],
  517:     start_namespace(Founder, ?NS,
  518:         #{mode => create, committee => Committee,
  519:           genesis_diff => quod_prolog:terms_to_diff(Terms),
  520:           external_predicate_modules => [quod_agent_predicates]}),
  521:     Anchor = call(Founder, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?NS]),
  522:     lists:foreach(fun(N) -> start_namespace(N, ?NS, join_config(Founder, Anchor)) end, Others),
  523:     lists:foreach(fun(N) ->
  524:         ok = call(N, quod_ct, await_applied, [?NS, 1, 30000]),
  525:         {ok, _} = call(N, quod_brahms, start_namespace,
  526:           [?NS, #{node_id => maps:get(endpoint, N), seed_peers => [maps:get(endpoint, Founder)]}])
  527:     end, [Founder | Others]),
  528:     Anchor.

  530: agent_policy(Old, Observers, Eligible, Administrator) ->
  531:     OldRef = maps:get(reference, Old), AdminRef = maps:get(reference, Administrator),
  532:     Goal = {'Goal'}, Principal = {'Principal'}, Value = {'Value'},
  533:     Guarded = {',', {current_ontology_identity, ?NS, {'_'}}, {call, Goal}},
  534:     Signing = {',', {agent_hosted, actor, Principal, {'Epoch'}, {'Key'}},
  535:                {sign_agent_request, {'Request'}, {'Signature'}}},
  536:     ObservationRights = [{agent_recovery_observer, actor, maps:get(reference, N)} || N <- Observers],
  537:     Placement = lists:append([[{eligible_agent_host, actor, maps:get(reference, N)},
  538:                               {agent_host_rank, actor, maps:get(reference, N), Rank}]
  539:                              || {N, Rank} <- lists:zip(Eligible, [1, 2])]),
  540:     SigningRights = [begin
  541:         {ok, Text} = quod_client_goal_parser:format_clause({record_recovered_work, V}),
  542:         Request = {agent_goal_v1, {'_'}, {agent_instance_ref, ?NS, {'_'}, actor},
  543:                    {'_'}, {'_'}, {'_'}, {'_'}, execute, 3, Text},
  544:         {':-', {can_request_agent_signature, Principal, actor, Request},
  545:          {eligible_agent_host, actor, Principal}}
  546:     end || V <- work_values()],
  547:     ObservationRights ++ Placement ++ SigningRights ++ [
  548:         {instance_of,{':',quod,{':',agent,agent}},actor},
  549:         {':-',{can_invoke,{'_'},Principal,[<<"quod:agent">>|{'_'}],?NS},
  550:               {agent_recovery_observer,actor,Principal}},
  551:         {agent_recovery_threshold, actor, 2}, {agent_domain_state, actor, before_loss},
  552:         {can_assign_agent_host, AdminRef, actor, none, 0, OldRef, {'_'}},
  553:         {':-', {can_invoke, Guarded, Principal, {'_'}, ?NS},
  554:          {',', {agent_recovery_observer, actor, Principal}, {failover_entry, Goal}}},
  555:         {failover_entry, agent({report_agent_observation,
  556:                           {agent_instance_ref,?NS,{'_'},actor},OldRef,1,
  557:                           {'_'},{'_'},{'_'},{'_'}})},
  558:         {failover_entry, agent({report_agent_observation_with_custody,
  559:                           {agent_instance_ref,?NS,{'_'},actor},OldRef,1,
  560:                           {'_'},{'_'},{'_'},{'_'},{'_'}})},
  561:         {failover_entry, agent({goal,{agent_hosted,
  562:                           {agent_instance_ref,?NS,{'_'},actor},OldRef,1,{'_'}}})},
  563:         {failover_entry, {trigger_event, {resume_work, Value}}},
  564:         {failover_entry, {record_delivery, durable_delivery}},
  565:         {':-', {record_delivery, Value}, {assertz, {delivered, Value}}},
  566:         {':-', {can_invoke, Signing, Principal, {'_'}, ?NS},
  567:          {agent_hosted, actor, Principal, {'Epoch'}, {'Key'}}},
  568:         {':-', {can_invoke, {record_recovered_work, Value},
  569:                  {agent_instance_ref, ?NS, {'_'}, actor}, {'_'}, ?NS},
  570:          {instance_of, {':',quod,{':',agent,agent}}, actor}},
  571:         {':-', {react_on, {resume_work, Value}, {record_recovered_work, Value}},
  572:          {me, {agent_instance_ref, ?NS, {'_'}, actor}}},
  573:         {':-', {record_recovered_work, Value}, conjunction([
  574:             {agent_domain_state, actor, before_loss},
  575:             {'\\+', {recovered_work, Value}}, {assertz, {recovered_work, Value}}])}].
  576: 
  577: install_grants(Observers, Old, Anchor) ->
  578:     OldRef = maps:get(reference, Old),
  579:     [Administrator | _] = Observers,
  580:     lists:foreach(fun(N) ->
  581:         Ref = {agent_instance_ref,?NS,Anchor,actor},
  582:         Reports = [agent({report_agent_observation,Ref,OldRef,1,{'_'},{'_'},{'_'},{'_'}}),
  583:                    agent({report_agent_observation_with_custody,Ref,OldRef,1,
  584:                           {'_'},{'_'},{'_'},{'_'},{'_' }})],
  585:         Initial = case N =:= Administrator of
  586:             true -> [agent({goal,{agent_hosted,Ref,OldRef,1,{'_'}}})]; false -> []
  587:         end,
  588:         Work = [{record_delivery, durable_delivery} |
  589:                 [{trigger_event, {resume_work, V}} || V <- work_values()]],
  590:         lists:foreach(fun(G) ->
  591:             committed(call(N, ?MODULE, submit_node,
  592:                            [{assertz, {can_execute_for, ?NS, Anchor, G}}]))
  593:         end, Reports ++ Initial ++ Work)
  594:     end, Observers).

  606: install_contacts(Recipients, Advertisers, RootAnchor, AgentAnchor, RootFounder) ->

  608:         lists:foreach(fun(Advertiser) ->
  609:             Ref = maps:get(reference, Advertiser),
  610:             {ok, Blob} = quod_wire_term:encode_canonical(Ref),
  611:             RootRole = case Advertiser =:= RootFounder of true -> validator; false -> observer end,
  612:             Hosted = [{?NS, AgentAnchor, validator, node}, {?ROOT, RootAnchor, RootRole, system},
  613:                       {<<"quod:agent">>,maps:get(agent_owner_anchor,Advertiser),RootRole,system},
  614:                       {maps:get(node_namespace, Advertiser), maps:get(node_anchor, Advertiser),
  615:                        validator, node}],
  616:             {ok, _} = call(N, quod_directory, install_generation,
  617:                 [#{author => {node_actor, Blob}, node_key => maps:get(public_key, Advertiser),
  618:                    endpoint => maps:get(endpoint, Advertiser), epoch => 1, generation => 1,
  619:                    page => 0, last => true, hosted => lists:sort(Hosted)}])
  620:         end, Advertisers)
  621:     end, Recipients).

  623: start_namespace(N, Ns, Extra) ->
  624:     Config = maps:merge(#{node_id => maps:get(public_key, N), identity => maps:get(identity, N),
  625:                          data_dir => maps:get(data_dir, N)}, Extra),
  626:     {ok, _} = call(N, quod_ns_sup, start_namespace, [Ns, Config]),
  627:     ok.

  629: join_config(Source, Anchor) ->
  630:     #{mode => join, genesis_hash => Anchor, seed_peers => [maps:get(endpoint, Source)]}.
  631: 
  632: %% The following helpers run on a peer through its stdio control connection.
  633: %% Every wait subscribes before its snapshot and advances only on owner events.
  634: bind_node(Ns, Anchor) ->
  635:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({node_actor, node}),
  636:     try
  637:         {ok, Principal} = quod_node_actor:bind(Ns, Anchor, <<"physical_node.">>, 2),
  638:         await_principal(Principal, quod_time:mono_ms() + 10000),
  639:         {ok, Principal}
  640:     after quod_reg:unsubscribe({node_actor, node}) end.
  641: 
  642: await_node_principal(Ref, Timeout) ->
  643:     {ok, Blob} = quod_wire_term:encode_canonical(Ref),
  644:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({node_actor, node}),
  645:     try await_principal({agent, Blob}, quod_time:mono_ms() + Timeout)
  646:     after quod_reg:unsubscribe({node_actor, node}) end.
  647: 
  648: await_principal(Principal, Deadline) ->
  649:     case quod_node_actor:principal() of
  650:         {ok, Principal} -> ok;
  651:         _ -> receive
  652:             {node_actor_installed, _, _} -> await_principal(Principal, Deadline)
  653:         after max(0, Deadline - quod_time:mono_ms()) -> error(node_principal_not_installed)
  654:         end
  655:     end.
  656: 
  657: submit_node(Goal) ->
  658:     {Numbered, _, _} = erlog_int:term_instance(Goal, 0),
  659:     {ok, Bytes, Signature} = quod_node_actor:signed_goal(execute, Numbered,
  660:         crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32), quod_time:now_ms() + 30000),
  661:     case quod_client_goal_ingress:submit(Bytes, Signature) of
  662:         {ok, _, {normalized, {pending, {operation, Ns, _, _, _} = Ref}}} ->
  663:             logger:warning("Pending operation evidence: ~p", [operation_diagnostics(Ns, Ref)]),
  664:             %% Observe this exact request's durable completion. Its signed
  665:             %% expiry is unchanged; neither this helper nor the runtime submits
  666:             %% it again or creates a replacement operation.
  667:             try quod_ct:await_operation_complete(Ns, Ref, 30000)
  668:             catch Class:Reason:Stack ->
  669:                 logger:warning("Unresolved operation evidence: ~p", [operation_diagnostics(Ns, Ref)]),
  670:                 erlang:raise(Class, Reason, Stack)
  671:             end,
  672:             quod_client_goal_ingress:resolve_operation(Bytes, Signature);
  673:         Result -> Result
  674:     end.
  675: 
  676: diagnostics() ->
  677:     [#{namespace => Ns, proof => quod_prolog:stats(Ns),
  678:        consensus => quod_simplex:stats(Ns), runtime => quod_runtime:stats(Ns),
  679:        status => maps:with([role, committed, approved, last_applied, recovery,
  680:                             progress_phase, progress_quorum_ready, proposal_open],
  681:                            quod_simplex:status(Ns)),
  682:        progress => progress_diagnostics(Ns)}
  683:      || Ns <- quod_prolog:namespaces()].
  684: 
  685: operation_diagnostics(Ns, Ref) ->
  686:     {_, State} = sys:get_state(quod_reg:where({quod_simplex, Ns})),
  687:     Recovery = maps:get(Ref, quod_simplex:test_operation_recoveries(State), #{}),
  688:     Targets = maps:get(target_ref, Recovery, []),
  689:     #{outcome => quod_prolog:local_outcome(Ns, Ref),
  690:       recovery => maps:with([claim_state, status, slot, target_ref, results], Recovery),
  691:       worker => case maps:get(pid, Recovery, undefined) of
  692:           Pid when is_pid(Pid) -> process_info(Pid,
  693:               [current_function, current_stacktrace, message_queue_len]);
  694:           _ -> none
  695:       end,
  696:       targets => [{T, quod_prolog:local_outcome(element(2, T), T)} || T <- Targets]}.
  697: 
  698: progress_diagnostics(Ns) ->
  699:     {_, State} = sys:get_state(quod_reg:where({quod_simplex, Ns})),
  700:     #{head => quod_simplex:test_progress(State),
  701:       position => quod_simplex:test_protocol_position(State),
  702:       pools => quod_simplex:test_engine_pool_sizes(State)}.
  703: 
  704: await_goal(Ns, Goal, Timeout) ->
  705:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({runtime, Ns}),
  706:     Owner = quod_reg:where({quod_prolog, Ns}),
  707:     Monitor = monitor(process, Owner),
  708:     try await_goal_read(Ns, Owner, Monitor, Goal, quod_time:mono_ms() + Timeout)
  709:     after demonitor(Monitor, [flush]), quod_reg:unsubscribe({runtime, Ns}) end.
  710: 
  711: await_goal_read(Ns, Owner, Monitor, Goal, Deadline) ->
  712:     case quod_prolog:prove_ro(Ns, Goal) of
  713:         {ok, [Bindings], Height} -> {Bindings, Height};
  714:         {fail, _} -> await_goal_edge(Ns, Owner, Monitor, Goal, Deadline);
  715:         {error, rebuilding} -> await_goal_edge(Ns, Owner, Monitor, Goal, Deadline);
  716:         Other -> error({unexpected_goal_result, Ns, Goal, Other})
  717:     end.
  718: 
  719: await_goal_edge(Ns, Owner, Monitor, Goal, Deadline) ->
  720:     receive
  721:         {projection_advanced, Owner, _} -> await_goal_read(Ns, Owner, Monitor, Goal, Deadline);
  722:         {replay_ready, _, _} -> await_goal_read(Ns, Owner, Monitor, Goal, Deadline);
  723:         {'DOWN', Monitor, process, Owner, Why} -> error({proof_owner_down, Why})
  724:     after max(0, Deadline - quod_time:mono_ms()) ->
  725:         error({goal_not_reached, Goal, quod_runtime:stats(Ns), quod_simplex:stats(Ns)})
  726:     end.
  727: 
  728: await_agent(Ref = {agent_instance_ref, Ns, _, _}, Epoch, Timeout) ->
  729:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({agent_hosting, Ns}),
  730:     try
  731:         {Owner, Children} = quod_runtime:agents(Ns),
  732:         case [{Owner, Pid, B} || #{pid := Pid, binding := #{reference := R, epoch := E} = B}
  733:                                    <- Children, R =:= Ref, E =:= Epoch] of
  734:             [Installed] -> Installed;
  735:             [] -> receive
  736:                 {agent_installed, Owner, Child, #{reference := Ref, epoch := Epoch} = B, _} ->
  737:                     {Owner, Child, B}
  738:             after Timeout -> error({agent_not_installed, Ref, Epoch, quod_runtime:stats(Ns)}) end
  739:         end
  740:     after quod_reg:unsubscribe({agent_hosting, Ns}) end.
  741: 
  742: %% Subscribe before the installed-state snapshot. The real observer owner
  743: %% publishes after changing its watch set; no handler revision is fabricated.
  744: await_observer(Height, Timeout) ->
  745:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({agent_hosting, ?NS}),
  746:     try
  747:         Owner = quod_reg:where({quod_runtime, ?NS}),
  748:         case gen_server:call(Owner, get_stats) of
  749:             #{observed_agent_instances := 1, e_frontier := H} when H >= Height -> ok;
  750:             _ -> receive
  751:                 {agent_observation_installed, Owner,
  752:                  #{observed_agent_instances := 1}, H} when H >= Height -> ok
  753:             after Timeout -> error({observation_not_installed, quod_runtime:stats(?NS)}) end
  754:         end
  755:     after quod_reg:unsubscribe({agent_hosting, ?NS}) end.
  756: 
  757: await_process_down(Pid, Timeout) ->
  758:     Monitor = monitor(process, Pid),
  759:     try receive {'DOWN', Monitor, process, Pid, _} -> ok
  760:         after Timeout -> error({stale_agent_survived, Pid}) end
  761:     after demonitor(Monitor, [flush]) end.
  762: 
  763: resumed_work(Ref = {agent_instance_ref, Ns, Anchor, _}, Runtime, Child, Value) ->
  764:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({agent, Ref}),
  765:     try
  766:         committed(submit_node({node_authorized_goal, Ns, Anchor,
  767:                                {trigger_event, {resume_work, Value}}})),
  768:         receive
  769:             {agent_request_finished, Runtime, Child, #{reference := Ref}, _, Result} ->
  770:                 committed(Result)
  771:         after 20000 -> error({resumed_work_not_completed, Value, quod_runtime:stats(Ns)}) end,
  772:         {#{}, Height} = await_goal(Ns, {recovered_work, Value}, 10000),
  773:         Height
  774:     after quod_reg:unsubscribe({agent, Ref}) end.
  775: 
  776: restart_runtime(Ref = {agent_instance_ref, Ns, _, _}, Runtime) ->
  777:     Sup = quod_reg:where({quod_ns, Ns}),
  778:     ok = supervisor:terminate_child(Sup, quod_runtime),
  779:     false = is_process_alive(Runtime),
  780:     {ok, _} = supervisor:restart_child(Sup, quod_runtime),
  781:     await_agent(Ref, 2, 10000).
  782: 
  783: assert_old_key_fenced(Ref = {agent_instance_ref, Ns, Anchor, actor}, OldKey) ->
  784:     {ok, Network} = quod_ontology:network_identity(),
  785:     Expires = quod_time:now_ms() + 30000,
  786:     Request = #{network_identity => Network, agent_namespace => Ns,
  787:       agent_genesis_anchor => Anchor, agent_instance_text => <<"actor.">>,
  788:       signing_public_key => OldKey, operation_id => crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32),
  789:       not_after_ms => Expires, mode => execute, parser_version => 2,
  790:       goal_text => <<"record_recovered_work(stale_old_host).">>},
  791:     %% Direct custody signing is the adversarial fixture: the retained key is
  792:     %% usable, but ordinary ingress must reject its revoked authority.
  793:     {ok, Bytes, Signature} = quod_agent_vault:sign(Request, quod_time:mono_ms() + 5000),
  794:     {ok, Blob} = quod_wire_term:encode_canonical(Ref),
  795:     ?assertMatch({ok, #{agent_ref_blob := Blob}}, quod_client_goal:verify(Bytes, Signature)),
  796:     ?assert(quod_time:now_ms() < Expires),
  797:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {failed, _}}},
  798:                  quod_client_goal_ingress:submit(Bytes, Signature)),
  799:     ?assert(quod_time:now_ms() < Expires),
  800:     ?assertMatch({fail, _}, quod_prolog:prove_ro(Ns, {recovered_work, stale_old_host})),
  801:     ok.
  802: 
  803: work_values() -> [after_recovery, after_runtime_restart, after_old_host_return].
  804: 
  805: committed({ok, _, {operation_outcome, _, #{status := completed, targets := Rows}}}) ->
  806:     ?assert(Rows =/= []),
  807:     lists:foreach(fun(Row) -> ?assertMatch({_, {committed, _}}, Row) end, Rows),
  808:     ok;
  809: committed(Result) ->
  810:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], _}}}, Result),
  811:     ok.
  812: 
  813: conjunction([G]) -> G;
  814: conjunction([G | Rest]) -> {',', G, conjunction(Rest)}.
  815: 
  816: call(#{peer := Peer}, Module, Function, Args) ->
  817:     peer:call(Peer, Module, Function, Args, 120000).
  818: 
  819: stop_peers(Peers) -> lists:foreach(fun(Peer) -> catch peer:stop(Peer) end, Peers).
  820: 
  821: agent(Goal) -> {'::',{':',quod,agent},Goal}.
